title: Slower pace, zoomable map, re-balance, character polish
problem: The owner finds the map slightly small or the characters too fast, asked to think of balance changes, and asked to polish the character designs and animations.
scope: Movement about 30% slower for every troop and hero; walk animation tied to distance walked
Zoomable map view: zoom button, double-tap and pinch (1x to 2x), drag to pan, clamped to the map; whole map by default
Re-balance after the slowdown with npm run balance (same targets as PLAN-005) plus pace (match length, draws)
Character polish: better proportions, shading and detail for 20 heroes and 22 troops; smoother animation (more walk frames, idle breathing, wind-up and strike, hit flash, spawn and fall)

acceptance.text: All troops and heroes move about 30% slower; the rules stay whole-number and deterministic (automated)
acceptance.evidence: rules.test.ts pace test: every troop and hero walks at 70% of its listed speed in whole units per tick (e.g. Silat Guard 9->6, Kera 15->11, Rimba 12->8); determinism 4/4 unchanged; 85/85 tests.

acceptance.text: Balance after the slowdown: npm run balance passes (species 40-60%, heroes 35-65%, draws under 15%, early finishes at most 10%)
acceptance.evidence: npm run balance after the slowdown (1,200 matches): species 45-56%, heroes 42-58%, draws 9.8%, decided before 2:30: 1 match, average 5:21. Pace kept by towers 1,700 health, waves +18% a minute and a 90 s sudden death (60 s was too short at the slower pace: draws 19%).

acceptance.text: Zoom and pan: button, double-tap and pinch zoom; pan when zoomed; orders and wave chips still work zoomed in (browser check)
acceptance.evidence: phone-check: zoom button zooms to 1.8x; dragging the zoomed map pans; dropping a hero on the zoomed map gives a new order; double-tap zooms back out; a two-finger pinch zooms to 2x; PHONE CHECK OK.

acceptance.text: Character polish: all heroes and troops redrawn and animated; sprite sheet reviewed; no slowdown on a phone-size screen
acceptance.evidence: All 20 heroes and 22 troops redrawn with cel shading, faces, trims and team pennants; 8 walk frames (steps follow distance walked), 4 idle, 3 attack beats, hit flash, spawn rise; sprite sheets and in-game screenshots reviewed; drawing 100 figures at 2x density takes under 1 ms a frame after warm-up.

acceptance.text: Same seed + same moves = same match; soak and phone check pass
acceptance.evidence: tests/determinism.test.ts 4/4; npm run soak 100 + 20 matches, no errors, every hero and species played; phone check OK.
Not yet tried on the owner's phone.

acceptance.text: Owner's verdict: pace right? map big enough? characters better?

risks: Slower movement can make matches drawn out: watched with the balance check (match length, draws)
Zoomed in, targets off the screen cannot be ordered until you pan or zoom out
Richer figures cost more drawing time: kept cached
cost: RM0. Free tools; private preview page. Several build sessions (estimate).
userNotes: Calmer pace: every troop and hero walks about 30% slower; steps now match how far a piece walks.
Zoom: tap the magnifier, double-tap or pinch the map to look closer (up to 2x), drag to look around.
Re-balanced for the slower pace: towers 1,700 health, waves grow 18% a minute, sudden death 1:30; species and heroes stay between 42% and 58% against the bot.
Polished characters: shading, faces, team pennants, smoother walking, breathing, attack swings, hit flashes and arrivals.

approval.evidence: the map feels slightly small/or the characters are just moving too fast ... think of balance changes ... polish the character designs and animations please
